00051 extern "C" void JNICALL Java_uk_co_miajo_UGen_UGenAudio_createIOHost(JNIEnv *env, jobject thiz, jdouble sr, jint numInputs, jint numOutputs, jint blockSize)

00053   __android_log_print(ANDROID_LOG_DEBUG, "ugen", "createIOHost %f %d %d %d", sr, numInputs, numOutputs, blockSize);

00057     host = createHost(sr, numInputs, numOutputs, blockSize);
